title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Data Literacy and Periodic Retesting
prompt: Some people believe that schools should place greater emphasis on teaching students how to interpret and question data than on preparing them for frequent formal retests of what they have learned. Others argue that regular retesting is the most reliable way to ensure that knowledge is genuinely retained. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有情境与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。写作时请注意：先分别说明两种观点各自的理由（例如数据素养对判断信息真伪的作用、阶段复测对巩固记忆与发现薄弱环节的作用），再明确给出你自己的立场，并用具体理由或例子支持。全文不少于250词，建议用约40分钟完成，写完后检查是否两方面都讨论到、观点是否清晰一致。
